desc: A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.

desc: In a deep trench dug under a city street at dusk, a young woman engineer in a white hard hat, an orange high-visibility jacket and work trousers climbs a ladder, holding on to a huge old riveted iron water main beside her, and looks up as she climbs. Around her the trench is crossed by more large pipes, a yellow gas pipe and bundles of black and orange cables, and an old brick sewer tunnel opens behind. Water trickles down the muddy walls, and above, cars pass on the road between lit brick buildings.
